title: [Lean] Restore saved exponents and refine ambient metadata XOR
body:
## Summary

Four unchanged independently accepted modules derive exact saved-exponent Cell restoration, admissible reference cleanup, finite-symbol exponent XOR refinement and its ambient segment consequence. Eighteen standard-only axiom probes and seven full printed types are source-bound in the public acceptance summary.

## Author-checked context

κ = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918. This is the unchanged selected PR1094 source context, not a new exponent or full multiplication theorem.

## Coverage

Parameterized reference coverage: arbitrary aligned dyadic Cells, exact forward-image restoration, source and post-ADD accumulator preservation. Finite-symbol coverage: actual marked paired rows, 5*w+4 first-halt transitions, w+2 local tape cells, literal cleared target bits and unchanged ambient spectators. Conditional interfaces remain explicit: Matches, restored-exponent equality for clearing, supplied marked input and clean scan scratch. Physical encoding/preparation, selected allocation, earlier accumulator recovery, global precision and full uniform bit-time remain open.

## Reuse

Four new sources total 21,074 bytes; eighteen exact public/import-derived prerequisites are reused, giving 22 research modules / 169,546 bytes. PR1840/1921 provide marked XOR/framing, PR2025/2370 supply reference arithmetic and aligned ADD, with credited immutable predecessors. Historical uncompiled comments are retained; later source-matched terminal acceptance is explicit. No source or compilation was repeated for publication. James Chang with OpenAI assistance, Apache-2.0; original attribution remains.

## Exact adoption

Publication parent: 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2. The five selected-result, assembly, selected-source and emitter blobs match the previously checked context exactly; contextual kappa is unchanged. No accepted proof was rerun for this adoption.
